page.layout: One printed page, title page. Centred title block in the middle of the page. Faint show-through from the reverse side above and below the title, not transcribed. Faint running head at the very top, treated as show-through.
page.notes: The date line prints CIↃ IↃ XXCVI; converted to Roman capitals as MDXXCVI, with [?] because the XX is uncertain. The ligature in HENRI?PETRI is not clear (possibly Æ or C); marked [?]. The faint lines above and below the title are show-through from the other side of the leaf and were left out. The top faint line that may read "EPISTOLA PAVLI AD COL." is also show-through, so no running head is given.
